svg.text: AGENTIC COMMERCE LAB · AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT SELECTION GUIDE & FAQ · 2026-11-08
Payment Rails (Stripe SPT vs Visa VIC vs x402/MPP) × Web Grounding (Web IQ vs Exa/Bright Data)
First-Principles FAQ Architecture Guide · 34 SPT Countries · 7.1x Token Reduction (680 vs 4,800 tok) · 12/12 Guarded Scenarios PASS
Q1 · HOW TO CHOOSE PAYMENT RAILS?
Split by AOV Granularity & Acquiring Model
• Retail / SaaS / Connect ($5–$5,000+): Choose Stripe SPT
(spt_... single-use, merchant + cap locked, 34 countries).
• Cross-Acquirer / Issuer Direct: Choose Visa VIC (VTS +
CVV2 + FIDO2 Passkey + TAP RFC 9421) or MC Agent Pay.
• API / Data Micropayments ($0.0001–$0.10): Choose x402
(USDC) or Stripe MPP (200-unit whole-cent step = $0 lost).
• Rule #1: Never expose raw 16-digit PAN or sk_live_ to LLM.
Q2 · HOW TO CHOOSE WEB GROUNDING?
Split by Caller-Code Raw Passage Visibility
• Pre-Checkout Price/Policy Guard: Choose Microsoft Web IQ
(/v3/search/web $7/1k + /v3/browse $1/1k passage <=3000c).
• Caller code sanitizes prompt injection & verifies SHA-256
price digest BEFORE the LLM sees retrieved web text.
• Neural Lookalike / Research: Choose Exa ($4–$7/1k).
• Login / Click Variant Modals: Bright Data Browser API.
• Chat Q&A Only (No Payment): Foundry Bing Grounding.
Q3 & Q4 · PROTOCOL & MCP SAFETY BOUNDARIES
Connect Splits, 4s Hooks & Nov 30 MCP Cutoff
• Stripe Connect: Omit Stripe-Account header on Destination
charges without on_behalf_of; use platform profile_... ID.
• Asymmetric 4s Hooks: Price timeout falls back to catalog
feed; finalize_checkout > 4,000ms auto-declines payment.
• Stripe MCP (Post-Nov 30, 2026): Blocks sk_live_ & untagged
rk_live_ (401); require OAuth 2.1 (RFC 9207) or Agent rk_live_.
• Affirm BNPL: Human must navigate WebView on own device.
4-LAYER ENTERPRISE AGENTIC COMMERCE PIPELINE (WHY SEARCH & PAYMENT MUST BE DECOUPLED)
1. BUYER MANDATE & INTENT
Google AP2 MandateVC
• Locks SKU, merchant & $80 cap
• Computes SHA-256 cart_digest
• Passkey / WebAuthn user proof
• Zero raw card data in prompt
2. READ-ONLY WEB GROUNDING
Microsoft Web IQ (G3 / global)
• /v3/search/web + /v3/browse passage
• 680 tokens/call (7.1x cut, 164ms P95)
• Checks liveCrawlSucceeded != false
• /news & /auto riskLevel recall check
3. DETERMINISTIC POLICY GATE
Pre-LLM Sanitizer & Broker
• Quarantines $990 snippet injection
• Blocks $79 -> $81 surge price drift
• Poppy summary ($0) == terms ($15)
• Refund/Treasury -> Human Confirm
4. SCOPED TOKEN SETTLEMENT
SPT / Visa VIC / x402 & MPP
• Single-use spt_live_7900 ($79 cap)
• Or Visa VIC VPP Passkey + TAP sig
• Or x402 / MPP 200-unit micro-step
• Emits sealed receipt + traceId
QUANTITATIVE BENCHMARK OUTCOMES (12/12 SCENARIOS PASS)
• Hidden Prompt Injection Block Rate: 100.0% (12/12 blocked, $79 mandate intact)
• Web IQ Passage Token Efficiency: 680 tok vs 4,800 tok full-doc (7.1x reduction)
• Search & Grounding Latency (Sealed Demo): 164 ms P95 passage / 240 ms catalog
• MPP Tempo 200-Unit Whole-Cent Alignment: $0.000000 forfeited (vs 54.3% loss)
✓ Full Regression Suite: 100% PASS (Zero live funds moved, zero credentials leaked)
WEB IQ COMPETITIVE MATRIX & MEASUREMENT HONESTY
• Official List Price: Web IQ /web $7/1k, /browse $1/1k · Exa lite $4/1k, auto $7/1k
• Bright Data Unlocker: $1.50/1k pay-as-you-go (Scale includes 383,000 requests)
• Tavily: $0.008/credit · Parallel Search: fast $1/1k (default mode is advanced $5/1k!)
• Honesty Rule: Live keys absent in CI -> latency marked not_measured (never 0ms)
